title: Choose Your Fighter II: Between Lines or Double Arrows
author: damo_89
rules:
Back in February I set a little 6x6. This puzzle had one grid, and the solver could choose whether they wanted to solve the puzzle with Between Lines or with Double Arrows, each netting a different solution. I knew I wanted to set a 9x9 with the same concept but neither constraint is particularly easy to work with and I kept setting into a cul-de-sac.

Eventually I managed to find a grid with a between lines set up that I liked, and a valid Double Arrow resolution as well. However, the double arrow version was unsolvable without extensive bifurcation so I had to add a couple extra clues to make this solvable by a human, or at least this human!

Both puzzles I expect to be in the 2-3 star range. Good luck!

• Normal sudoku rules apply: Place the digits 1 to 9 once each in every row, column, and 3x3 box

• Odd: Digits on an orange circle must be odd
• Then choose:
• Between Lines: Digits on a pink line must be strictly between the digits in the attached circles
• Double Arrows: Digits on a jade green line must sum to the same number as the sum of the two attached circles

Play Between Lines on Sudokupad

Play Double Arrows on Sudokupad

Download full solution guide for both puzzles (PDF)
solutionCode: Row 1 of Between Lines followed by Row 1 of Double Arrows (18 digits)
